ruling.recommended_action: Issue Ryde voucher of $1.41 to the rider (unexempt detour of ~1.0 km × $1.41/km metered rate); no account flag required.

segment_findings.reason: Tampines loop (GPS 09:32–09:40): driver turns north off the quoted ECP-eastbound corridor at ~1.3112/103.9408, loops through 1.3132–1.3200, and turns back to rejoin at ~1.3119/103.9466; ~1.0 km extra vs the shortest/most direct route, breaching RD-1. Not exempt: RD-4 (no traffic incidents; only band-4 speed bands on the replaced corridor, so no reasonable cause), RD-3 (no rider-named stop and no chat/app route request), RD-5 (no prior rider agreement). Refundable under RD-2 at $1.41/km metered rate.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement 'I followed my GPS; it rerouted me' is not a reasonable cause under RD-4: no traffic incident fact exists and the corridor speed bands are band 4 (free flow). System GPS records override the statement.
